data.long_meaning: Mubdi' is derived from the Arabic word 'abda' which means 'to initiate' or 'to innovate'. It signifies the one who begins something new or unique. The name Mubdi' carries the meaning “Initiator, Innovator” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Mubdi' usually hope their child will grow to embody initiator, innovator and live with faith, good character and purpose.
